candidate_classification.description: Phase-Field Regularization Length-Scale Sensitivity Candidate (l0 = 0.01125 mm)
candidate_classification.scientific_interpretation: Length-scale sensitivity intermediate solve (l0 = 0.01125 mm, 41,912 elements, Exit 1 cutback-terminated at u = 0.005839 mm). Pre-peak elastic compliance remains invariant (Delta K0 = -0.1305%). Peak load decreases to F_max = 0.7084 kN (Delta F_max = -6.52% vs S1, -2.66% vs L3), demonstrating the expected physical trend of decreasing peak load with increasing regularization length scale l0.
